Eligibility of Tenderer : C. Qualification Criteria
1. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 05(Five) years.
2. The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management
Contractor in construction works of at least 1 (One) contract of electrification work of road or similar nature of works successfully
completed within the
last 5(Five) years, with a value of at least BDT 50,00,000.00 (Fifty lac) in any government, semi-government or autonomous body.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk BDT 100.00 (one hundred) lac over the best
3(Three) years in the last 5(Five) years.
4. The minimum amount of liquid assets i.e working capital or credit line(s) of the
Tenderers shall be Tk BDT 40.00 (Forty) lac.
5. The bidder must have up to date Electrical A-B-C licences from electrification licencing Board.
[usually the required liquid asset is the equivalent of one fourth of the official estimated cost of the proposed work]
